name: Yodobashi Akiba
desc: Nine-floor electronics mall next to the station. Games, toys, tax-free, food court. The family stop if you only do one Akiba building. Price: free to enter; budget the kid a cap before the toy floors.

name: Gachapon Kaikan
desc: Hundreds of capsule machines in one hall. Cash, 20–40 minutes is plenty. Set a yen limit at the door. Closed some New Year days; check X before you walk. Price: about ¥200–¥500 a play.

name: Akihabara UDX lights
desc: Winter lights on the UDX plaza, typical mid-December to late January. Free after Yodobashi or Kanda Myojin. Confirm dates on the building site; shops inside may be under works. Price: free.
